title: Ransomware Without Data Theft Can Still Trigger Mandatory Breach Reporting Under India’s DPDP Law: K7 CyberSecurity
content_md: CXO Today reports: A ransomware attack that locks up corporate systems can legally qualify as a reportable personal data breach in India—even if hackers never steal a single file.
